notes.title: Nocturnal Nemesis v2.0 Now Available (Early Access Release)
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

We're excited to announce that [b]Version 2.0[/b] of [i]Nocturnal Nemesis[/i] is now live for players on the [b]default branch[/b]! This marks the beginning of our [b]Early Access phase[/b], bringing major changes, new features, and significant improvements over the original alpha demo.

🆕 [b]What’s New in v2.0:[/b]

🚨 [b]Early Access Expansion[/b] – A deeper, longer, and more atmospheric experience.

🌌 [b]New Areas[/b] – Explore fresh environments filled with new secrets and tension.

🧠 [b]Improved AI[/b] – Smarter, creepier enemy behavior to keep you on edge.

📹 [b]Enhanced Visuals[/b] – New effects, lighting tweaks, and refined performance.

🛠️ [b]Core Systems Reworked[/b] – Major backend improvements for stability and smoother gameplay.

🔊 [b]Audio Overhaul[/b] – Immersive sound design with expanded ambient and environmental effects.

🔐 [b]Accessing v2.0:[/b]

This update is [b]password-protected[/b] as part of a [b]limited Early Access rollout.[/b]
